name: Fordham Park Playground
description: Lewisham Council park with a play area and sandpit for children under 6. The council also lists a large climbing frame, a youth shelter, table tennis tables, an area for ball games, a trim trail, an informal football pitch, a cycle route, How to get into Fordham Park, Access to the park is via:, Pagnell Street, Achilles Street, Edward Street, Childeric Road and The park is open 24 hours.
